final_answer:
The root cause is that `src/checkout.js:12` read the flag with `flagsmith.getValue("checkout_button")`, which records no exposure, so users were never enrolled in the experiment and their purchases were never attributed to a variant.

I changed that line to `flagsmith.getExperimentFlag("checkout_button")?.value`. This is the SDK call that records the exposure.

I ran the local `experiment-doctor` against `evidence.json`, with no Flagsmith calls. Before the fix it reported `REPAIR_REQUIRED` (ED-011). After the fix it reports no defects and `PENDING`.

The experiment is still short of data (about 170 identities per variant and 0 conversions). Exposures should now be recorded for new sessions, so conversions should start to show up, but only a fresh pull of results will confirm that. I haven't committed the change.

I couldn't load the `flagsmith-experiment-doctor` skill through the Skill tool, so I ran the CLI bundled in `node_modules` directly.
